<td id="A1.T10.5.9.4" class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_border_bb" style="padding-left:4.0pt;padding-right:4.0pt;"><span id="A1.T10.5.9.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">8.30<span id="A1.T10.5.9.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> <math id="A1.T10.m29" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>±</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm</annotation></semantics></math> 0.52</span></span></td>
<td id="A1.T10.5.9.5" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb" style="padding-left:4.0pt;padding-right:4.0pt;"><span id="A1.T10.5.9.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">15.98<span id="A1.T10.5.9.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> <math id="A1.T10.m30" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>±</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm</annotation></semantics></math> 0.53</span></span></td>
<td id="A1.T10.5.9.6" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb" style="padding-left:4.0pt;padding-right:4.0pt;"><span id="A1.T10.5.9.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">0.6006 <math id="A1.T10.m31" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>±</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm</annotation></semantics></math> 0.0032</span></td>
<td id="A1.T10.5.9.7" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb" style="padding-left:4.0pt;padding-right:4.0pt;"><span id="A1.T10.5.9.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">0.1373 <math id="A1.T10.m32" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>±</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm</annotation></semantics></math> 0.0021</span></td></tr>
</table>
</figure>
<div class="ltx_pagination ltx_role_newpage"></div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="Ax1" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix">NeurIPS Paper Checklist</h2>

<div id="Ax1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<ol id="Ax1.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="Ax1.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Claims</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We have clearly described contributions and scope in the abstract and introduction.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A <span id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span> or <span id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix4.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Limitations</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We provide the limitations in the Appendix (see the “Limitations” section).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper has no limitation while the answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span> means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix8.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Theory assumptions and proofs</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix11.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification:
Formal proofs are provided in Appendix A1.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not include theoretical results.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix12.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Experimental result reproducibility</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix13.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix14.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix14.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix15.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix15.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification:
We have described the model architecture and experiment setting carefully.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not include experiments.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the paper includes experiments, a <span id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span> answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example</p>
<ol id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(a)</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(b)</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(c)</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(d)</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix16.I1.i5.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.</p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">5.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Open access to data and code</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix17" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix17.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix17.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix18" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix18.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix18.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix18.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix19" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix19.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix19.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We will release the code and model after the paper has been accepted.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines (<a href="https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy</a>) for more details.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so <span id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span> is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines (<a href="https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy</a>) for more details.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix20.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">6.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Experimental setting/details</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix21" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix21.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix21.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix22" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix22.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix22.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix22.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix23" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix23.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix23.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: The training and test details are provided in the Experiments section.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix24" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix24.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix24.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not include experiments.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix24.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">7.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Experiment statistical significance</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix25" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix25.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix25.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix26" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix26.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix26.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix26.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix27" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix27.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix27.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We report 95% confidence
intervals for the TTS results and the subjective listening tests. Due to the high computational cost, we do not report statistical significance for the general USE results.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not include experiments.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span> if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix28.I1.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">8.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Experiments compute resources</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix29" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix29.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix29.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix30" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix30.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix30.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix30.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix31" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix31.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix31.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We provide our computing requirements in the experiment section.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix32" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix32.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix32.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not include experiments.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix32.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">9.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Code of ethics</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix33" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix33.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix33.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics <a href="https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines</a>?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix34" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix34.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix34.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix34.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix35" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix35.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix35.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We follow NeurIPS Code of Ethics to keep anonymity, etc.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix36" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix36.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix36.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the authors answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span>, they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix36.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">10.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Broader impacts</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix37" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix37.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix37.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix38" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix38.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix38.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix38.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix39" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix39.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix39.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: For USE, the primary application is to improve communication with limited or no societal impact.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If the authors answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> or <span id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF8000;">[No] </span>, they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix40.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">11.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i11.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i11.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Safeguards</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix41" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix41.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix41.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix42" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix42.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix42.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix42.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix43" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix43.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix43.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: We don’t think our model needs safeguards to prevent misuse.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix44" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix44.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix44.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper poses no such risks.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix44.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">12.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i12.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Licenses for existing assets</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix45" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix45.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix45.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix46" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix46.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix46.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix46.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix47" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix47.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix47.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: The related information is explicitly mentioned and properly cited.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not use existing assets.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, <a href="https://paperswithcode.com/datasets" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">paperswithcode.com/datasets</a> has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix48.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">13.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i13.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">New assets</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix49" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix49.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix49.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix50" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix50.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix50.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix50.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix51" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix51.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix51.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: All the audio demos provided on the demo page are properly cited.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix52" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix52.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix52.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not release new assets.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix52.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">14.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i14.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix53" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix53.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix53.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix54" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix54.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix54.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix54.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix55" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix55.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix55.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification:
This information is provided in the Appendix related to the subjective test.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix56" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix56.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix56.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix56.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">15.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i15.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i15.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix57" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix57.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix57.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix58" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix58.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix58.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix58.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;">[Yes] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix59" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix59.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix59.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: It is not required to get an IRB for our subjective test.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix60" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix60.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix60.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix60.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">16.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i16.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="Ax1.I1.i16.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Declaration of LLM usage</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix61" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix61.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix61.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does <em id="Ax1.I1.ix61.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">not</em> impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix62" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix62.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix62.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer: <span id="Ax1.I1.ix62.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix63" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix63.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix63.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Justification: The core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important components.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix64" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"></span>
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix64.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix64.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Guidelines:</p>
<ul id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The answer <span id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">[N/A] </span> means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.ix64.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
</section>
